settings.heading: T50 AIR 2nd Generation
settings.alt: SIDIZ T50 AIR 2nd Generation full-mesh office chair in motion
settings.description:
The T50 AIR analyses the real usage data and reviews of three million sitters, adding an overwhelming coolness to precise personal fitting. High-stiffness Airflex mesh runs across the whole chair, seat included, circulating body heat and sweat in real time.

Through long hours of focus, it holds firm support and crisp freshness at once - comfortable in every season.

settings.heading: SIDIZ T50 AIR 2nd Generation Ergonomic Office Computer Mesh Chair
settings.body:
Custom Mechanism Airy Full Mesh Chair - built on the real usage data of three million sitters, with the subtle discomforts and play of the old design engineered out, and high-stiffness Airflex mesh from backrest to seat for all-day coolness with a firm, tailored fit: SIDIZ's premium full-mesh office chair.

  • Wide Mesh Headrest & 2D Lumbar Support - a 310 mm wide mesh headrest that cradles the nape through frequent posture changes, and a lumbar support with the pressure-point feel and slip-down fully resolved, meeting the lumbar curve with precise 50 mm height and 10 mm depth adjustment.
  • Airflex Full Mesh Seat & 4D Waterfall Armrest - a high-resilience mesh seat that circulates body heat and sweat in real time, interchangeable with the fabric seat and self-replaceable through Easy Repair, plus waterfall armrests raised 25 mm at base height with 4D fine adjustment to ease shoulder fatigue.
  • Synchronised & 5-Step Limited Tilting - sync tilt that keeps the back in contact as you recline, with a 105-130 degree five-step range and fine tension control that protects the lumbar.

Optimised for offices, home offices and studies - everywhere long sitting cycles between focus and rest, and a plain chair's limits show on a hot day.

settings.question: What changed in the fully redesigned T50 AIR 2nd Generation?
settings.answer: The 2nd Generation carries the S-line identity of the three-million-selling T50 family while resolving the frustrations real users reported: a wide lumbar support with the play and pressure-point feel engineered out, a 310 mm wide mesh headrest, and 4D armrests raised 25 mm. On the AIR, high-stiffness Airflex mesh runs across the whole chair, seat included, and the seat interchanges with the fabric T50 seat - each sold separately for self-service Easy Repair.

settings.question: I get lower-back pain at the computer - does it support the lumbar properly?
settings.answer: Yes. The pad's contact area is much wider than before (290 by 160 mm), removing the single-point pressure of the old design, and a flexible material follows your lumbar curve closely. Height (50 mm) and depth (10 mm) adjust precisely, the depth lever can tuck the support away entirely if you prefer no contact, and the slip-down and play of the first generation are engineered out.

settings.question: How does the tilting work, and what is the recline range?
settings.answer: The T50 2nd Generation uses a synchronised tilt: as you recline, backrest and seat move at different optimal angles so the body does not slide. The recline limit sets in five steps from 105 to 130 degrees, and backrest tension fine-tunes across 23 lever turns.

settings.question: Fabric seat (T50) or mesh seat (T50 AIR) - which should I choose?
settings.answer: The T50's fabric seat pairs a bowl-shaped form with scooping compression for a firm, stable sit without pressure points, and its cover removes for machine washing. The T50 AIR's seat applies stiff, resilient Airflex mesh across the whole surface for maximum airflow, and a separate fabric cover can be fitted when mesh feels too cool. The two seats interchange on either chair.

settings.question: Does it ease wrist and shoulder tension over long sittings?
settings.answer: Yes. The 4D armrests adjust in height (60 mm), fore-and-aft (30 mm), angle (20 degrees) and width (10 mm), supporting from elbow to wrist in any posture, and the waterfall-shaped pad prevents forearm pressure when you lean. The maximum height is also up 25 mm on previous SIDIZ chairs, resolving armrests that sat too low for taller sitters or higher desks.

settings.question: When parts wear out, do I have to replace the whole chair?
settings.answer: No. The T50 2nd Generation was designed for Easy Repair from the start: the headrest, armrest pads, seats and seat covers - the parts that wear or stain first - will be sold individually so you can swap them at home, and the chair carries a 5-year warranty with product registration.
